summary.headline: Preface to the Venetian Volume
summary.text: Preface to the Venetian volume explains the catalogue’s purpose and collaborative method, and highlights important astrological excerpts from Marcian manuscripts concerning Dorotheus, Vettius Valens, Anubio, Firmicus Maternus, and Antiochus’s Chaldean dodecaeteris. It credits Wilhelm Kroll, Alexander Olivieri, and the editors’ work in describing and publishing the manuscripts.
